summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] An event was prepared where 30 teams of 10 undergraduate students from Seoul National University and KAIST competed in robot production. ESS stores a large amount of electricity produced by renewable energy such as solar and wind power and plays a role in stably supplying it to the AI data center when necessary.
